title: MV I need some help to find sprite sheets

posts.author: ana_lulu
posts.body: Hey there! I'm new at this forum (and also new using RPG Maker MV). So, I'm in a school project where I have to make a educational game about a brazilian animal called cuíca (it looks a bit like a rat) and I'm having troubles to find sprites sheets that would look like it. I'm not that talented, so it's difficult to me to make one sprite by my own... Any thoughts? I really need help

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I had never heard of this animal. I looked at the images and it's impossible to recreate it using only pixel art without it being confused with several other marsupials, and besides, at first glance it's easily mistaken for a rodent.
The only way to recreate such a creature would be to recreate the environment as well.
Furthermore, it's not an animal that moves like most, so the best thing for a recent school project would be a hand-drawn sketch or sculpture.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
I also never heard of this thing, but since I have already made a mouse sprite, I thought I could give it a stab so you can do your school project
The terms of use are as in
my MZ thread
, but you do not have to own MZ since both the base mouse and everything I did today were made by me from scratch.
